subject: Post-call: deployment path, economic buyer & SLA thresholds
messages:
From: Connor Obrien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Ng <alyssa@mediotech.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@mediotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: deployment path, economic buyer & SLA thresholds

Hi Alyssa / Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and the asks we agreed to close out next: 

1) Decision criteria we heard from your side:
   - Latency target: p95 inference latency <= 250ms for the patient-facing summarization flow (50-150 tokens).
   - Cost target: unit cost / 1k tokens should be below your current vendor by ~30% over monthly run-rate.
   - Deployment preference: Private VPC for PHI; consider Dedicated reserved capacity if usage grows > 10M tokens/month.
   - SLA: 99.9% uptime target with incident response SLA and runbook access.

2) Stakeholder mapping (please confirm):
   - Economic buyer: Samir Patel (VP Product Ops) — procurement + budget approval
   - Security & compliance: Alyssa Ng (Head of InfoSec) — SOC 2 evidence, data residency, KMS
   - Procurement: procurement@mediotech.com — contract terms and PO process

3) Action items we committed to:
   - I’ll send a short comparison doc with deployment modes + latency/cost tradeoffs (attachment).
   - Marissa will draft a preliminary quote and a 30/60/90 rollout cost estimate.
   - We’ll prepare SOC 2 summary and answer your security questionnaire by next Wednesday.

Can you confirm the economic buyer and the expected procurement timeline (PO vs. SOW)? If there are any additional stakeholders (legal, privacy), please loop them in.

Attachments: redwood-deployment-options.pdf (summary of Hosted/Dedicated/Private), prelim-quote-8371.xlsx (placeholder numbers)

Thanks —
Connor
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Alyssa Ng <alyssa@mediotech.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@mediotech.com>
Cc: procurement@mediotech.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: deployment path, economic buyer & SLA thresholds

Connor —

Appreciate the recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirming: I own the security checklist and will run the SOC 2 artefacts. We’ll need your SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months) and a network diagram showing VPC peering options.
- Economic buyer is Samir, but Legal (Tanya Gomez) will need to approve data processing terms — looping her in once we have redlines.
- Procurement timeline: if pricing and T&Cs look standard we can aim for PO within 4–6 weeks after final quote. If legal needs redlines it may take 8–10 weeks.
- Latency: 250ms p95 is the target; however for device-triage workflow we may accept up to 350ms during initial rollout. Please call out expected p95 at 150-token and 300-token lengths in the quote.

Also: can you provide a simple cost model showing Dedicated reserved vs. Private on-prem (CAPEX estimate)? Our finance team prefers a TCO view for year 1.

Thanks,
Alyssa Ng
Head of InfoSec, Mediotech Health
alyssa@mediotech.com

From: Connor Obrien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Ng <alyssa@mediotech.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@mediotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, procurement@mediotech.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: deployment path, economic buyer & SLA thresholds

Thanks Alyssa — that's very helpful. Quick replies inline and next steps: 

- SOC 2: attaching a one-page SOC 2 summary now (soc2-summary.pdf). We’ll follow up with the full report under NDA if needed. Network diagram: will include a VPC peering and private endpoint option in the deployment doc.
- Legal: noted Tanya Gomez (we haven’t met her yet). Samir, if you can share contact for Tanya I’ll include her on the T&Cs thread and propose a redline window.
- Latency callouts: we’ll provide p95 estimates at ~150 tokens and 300 tokens for each deployment mode and a short note on how batching/kv-caching changes those numbers. Expect the table in the quote.
- Cost model: Marissa will prepare a 1-year TCO comparing Dedicated reserved, Private VPC (cloud-hosted), and on-prem (CAPEX + infra ops).

Proposed near-term plan:
- By Wed (2026-10-07): send updated quote + latency table + network diagram + SOC 2 summary.
- Week of Oct 12: if procurement proceeds, schedule a short 30-min SOW/PO clarification call with Samir + Tanya + procurement.

If that timeline works I’ll mark the deal in HubSpot as "Discovery — Procure" and attach the pack.

Regards,
Connor

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Connor Obrien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: deployment path, economic buyer & SLA thresholds

Connor —

I’ll own the numbers. I’ll convert the preliminary worksheet into a 1-page TCO and a separate Dedicated vs Private quote with line items. Will include p95 latency estimates and note assumptions (batching window, sequence length distribution, expected QPS).

Action: give me the target token distribution (percent under 100 tokens / 100–300 / 300+) if you have it from the call notes; I’ll bake into the costing. Otherwise I’ll use a conservative split.

I’ll also prepare the DocuSign-ready quote file and drop in Drive (link in the HubSpot deal).

-Marissa
Sr. Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
